title: 第17章 弱肉强食的世界只能挥剑对敌第18章 人生无退路仗剑初杀敌
content_zh:
“陆公子，事情已经妥了。”
一处无人的地方，赵志一脸谄媚的对陆晨说道。
“真的？”
陆晨闻言一脸狂喜。
“顾余生真的死了？”
“他已经三天没有在桃花林练剑了。”赵志搓着手，“那一只妖兽，拥有上古血脉，不但体魄强大，还拥有远超其他妖兽的智慧，为了让它暴走，我可是花了极大的代价才从天灵峰的一位御兽长老那弄来的药粉，你答应我的事……”
陆晨皱眉道：“活要见人，死要见尸，我这些日子，依旧无法摆脱天道誓言的影响，你说那贱种会不会还活着？”
“这……可能微乎其微。”赵志眯着眼睛，“陆公子，你不会反悔吧？”
“不是反悔，你亲自去一趟，看看他是不是真的死了。”陆晨说到这，忽然想到什么，“刚刚你说什么，那一只妖兽拥有上古血脉？是一只什么妖兽？”
赵志眼睛贼溜溜一转，打了个哈哈：“一只凶妖，很难驯服的那种，我去一趟桃花林，看看那小子究竟死了没。”
说完，赵志转身就走，嘴角露出一抹冷意，那一只雪猿，他早就盯上了，可惜他天赋不足，御兽的功法还没有练到家，退一万步讲，如果他得不到，也会将这个重要的信息用来攀附那位玄龙王朝的九皇子。
“这家伙……”
陆晨眼中也露出一丝怀疑，不过对他而言，顾余生的生死，才是最关心的。
瀑布后方的寒洞内。
顾余生正在将银色的元胎之气洗练，一点点的转为金色。
这三天时间，他没有练剑，而是专注于炼化元胎之气，提升品级。
一旦所有的银色元胎之气转化为金色，他就打算利用功法凝结元胎，正式进入元胎境。
按照顾余生的估计，最多三五天的时间就能成功。
就在此时，守在外面的雪猿脚踏罡风悄然进来，出现在顾余生面前，指了指外面。
“终于来了吗？”

顾余生轻吐一口气，体内的所有元胎之气藏于丹田，他手持木剑，悄然走出寒洞。
数十丈外，有一道身影藏在一块石头后面，鬼鬼祟祟。
“是他？”
顾余生眼中露出一丝冷意，此人，正是陆展的记名弟子，入门那一头，他竟然贪图宗门发给新晋弟子的银钱，顾余生戳穿他的小动作，被对方怀恨在心。
而对方出手暗害自己，顾余生也就不觉得奇怪了。
“开脉境吗？”
顾余生皱眉。
他现在虽然没有进入元胎境，但六识敏锐，能够觉察得到赵志身上的气息，此人骨架偏大，偏偏呈现佝偻瘦小之状，应该是在开脉境界修行的时候出了岔子，才导致他这样。
作为五年前招收进来的上一届青云门弟子，开脉境并不算天赋太好，但也不是很差，毕竟五年时间，有很多人还连元胎都没有凝结。
“此人狡诈，如果我不现身，他肯定会溜走，如果我现身，却极有可能和他正面交手。”
顾余生目光闪动，他的血液不知不觉间竟然兴奋的流淌。
“或许，我可以和他一战！”
心中起了这样的念头，顾余生的拳头不由自主的紧捏，他看一眼那一株悬崖边的桃树，又看了看旁边的雪猿。
早就已经计划周密的数种预案在心中再次推演，他甚至想到数种于暗处谋害的方案，可他现在只想以剑证明自己。
“你躲到那边去。”
content_en:
"Master Lu, the matter has been settled."
In a deserted place, Zhao Zhi said to Lu Chen with a flattering look.
"Really?"
Lu Chen was ecstatic when he heard this.
"Gu Yusheng is really dead?"
"He hasn't practiced his sword in the Peach Blossom Forest for three days." Zhao Zhi rubbed his hands. "That monster has ancient bloodline. Not only is it physically powerful, but it also has wisdom that far exceeds other monsters. In order to make it go berserk, I spent a lot of money to get the powder from a beast-controlling elder in Tianling Peak. You promised me..."
Lu Chen frowned and said: "I want to see people alive, and I want to see corpses when I die. These days, I still can't get rid of the influence of the oath of heaven. Do you think that bitch is still alive?"
"This... may be trivial." Zhao Zhi squinted his eyes, "Mr. Lu, you won't regret it, right?"
"It's not that you regret it. Go there yourself and see if he is really dead." When Lu Chen said this, he suddenly thought of something, "What did you just say? That monster has ancient bloodline? What kind of monster is it?"
Zhao Zhi's eyes rolled around and he said, "It's a ferocious monster that's difficult to tame. I'll go to the peach blossom forest to see if that kid is dead."
After saying that, Zhao Zhi turned around and left with a cold look on his lips. He had already targeted the snow ape, but unfortunately he was not talented enough and had not yet mastered the skills of controlling beasts. To put it bluntly, if he could not get it, he would use this important information to pursue the Ninth Prince of the Xuanlong Dynasty.
"This guy..."
There was also a trace of doubt in Lu Chen's eyes, but for him, Gu Yusheng's life and death was what he cared about the most.
In the cold cave behind the waterfall.
Gu Yusheng was refining the silver Yuan Fei Qi, turning it into gold bit by bit.
In the past three days, he did not practice swordsmanship, but focused on refining the energy of the Yuan Fei and improving his level.
Once all the silver Yuan Fei Qi is converted into gold, he plans to use the technique to condense the Yuan Fei and officially enter the Yuan Fei realm.
According to the estimate of Taking Care of Yusheng, it will take at most three to five days to succeed.
At this moment, the snow monkey who was guarding outside came in quietly, stepping on the strong wind, appeared in front of Gu Yusheng, and pointed outside.
"Is it finally here?"
Gu Yusheng breathed out lightly. All the energy of Yuan Fei in his body was hidden in his Dantian. He held the wooden sword and quietly walked out of the cold cave.
A few dozen feet away, there was a figure hiding behind a stone, sneaking around.
"Is it him?"
There was a hint of coldness in Gu Yusheng's eyes. This person was Lu Zhan's registered disciple. On the other side of the entrance, he actually coveted the money given to new disciples by the sect. Gu Yusheng exposed his little tricks and was resented by the other party.
Gu Yusheng didn't find it strange that the other party tried to harm him.
"Opening Pulse Realm?"
Gu Yusheng frowned.
Although he has not entered the Yuan Fei Realm now, his six senses are sharp and he can detect the aura on Zhao Zhi's body. This person's frame is too big, but he is rickety and thin. It should be that something went wrong while practicing in the Kaimai Realm, which caused him to be like this.
As a disciple of the last Qingyun Sect who was recruited five years ago, his talent at the Pulse Opening Realm is not very good, but it is not bad either. After all, many people have not even condensed their Yuan Fei in five years.
"This man is cunning. If I don't show up, he will definitely slip away. If I show up, I will most likely fight him head-on."
Gu Yusheng's eyes flashed, and his blood flowed with excitement unknowingly.
"Maybe I can fight him!"
With such a thought in his mind, Gu Yusheng's fists clenched involuntarily. He glanced at the peach tree on the edge of the cliff, and then at the snow ape next to him.
Several well-planned plans were replayed in his mind, and he even thought of several plans to murder in the dark, but now he just wanted to prove himself with his sword.
"You hide over there."
